measurement_description: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the internal validity of LLM benchmarks, specifically investigating whether simple n-gram features can predict correct answers in multiple-choice reasoning and language understanding tasks, a phenomenon known as the 'Clever Hans' effect.
